top_signals.title: Markets Await Key Economic Data This Week
top_signals.summary:
Markets are poised for a slight uptick in US inflation this week, along with cooling economic expansion in the UK. Bloomberg's Morwenna Coniam speaks to Tom Mackenzie and Guy Johnson on 'Bloomberg: The Opening Trade.'
 (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Meiji Yasuda Life Watching Policy Surrenders as Rates Rise
top_signals.summary: Meiji Yasuda Life Insurance Co. is examining an industrywide increase in policy cancellations as rising interest rates prompt customers to shift into other financial products, its Deputy President Atsushi Nakamura said in an interview.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Berkshire earnings rose last quarter and CEO Greg Abel is starting to deploy Buffett's massive cash hoard
top_signals.summary: Strength across its energy, railroad and manufacturing businesses more than offset weaker insurance results.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
